## Adding or changing icons

- [ ] Files are `icons/<outline|solid>/<name>.svg`, kebab-case, no Style suffix
- [ ] 24×24 viewBox, 2px margin, filled paths only (strokes outlined), single colour
- [ ] Category and tags added to `icons/meta.json`
- [ ] `npm run build` passes and the updated `icons/codepoints.json` is committed
